name: Readwise Reader
summary: Read-it-later app for articles, newsletters, RSS, PDFs and highlights, part of Readwise.
description: Readwise Reader saves web articles, newsletters, RSS feeds, PDFs and other documents to one place, with highlighting and search. It is part of Readwise, which resurfaces past highlights through a daily review. Both start with a 30-day free trial; the Full plan including Reader costs $9.99 per month billed annually, and the Lite plan $5.59 per month. Reader is designed to replace several separate reading apps.
